name: himalaya-impl
description: The himalaya@1 provider `cli`: typed mail actions built as himalaya argv strings and executed THROUGH the general service (container | ssh | ssh+container | local | http), so himalaya works with no binary on the workbench PATH. Not-configured is a valid state.

config.description: The plugin is transport agnostic: `general` is a general-service@1 config row (type + params) naming WHERE himalaya runs; no mail account, image, host or path is hard-coded here.

timeoutMs.description: Per-call timeout handed to the transport (ms)

generalWaitMs.description: Bound of the SOFT wait for the general service at load (ordering hint, never a dependency)
